content.text: {"abstained": false, "abstention_reason": "", "answer": "The Internship Programme of the Department of Expenditure is a central sector scheme [E01] that aims to familiarize eligible undergraduates pursuing five-year integrated courses and graduates pursuing post-graduation or research with the overall process of formulation of economic policies of the Government [E01]. The internship lasts two to six months at different points during the financial year [E01]. Interns receive token remuneration of ₹10,000 per month upon satisfactory completion and submission of their report/paper [E01]. They are provided with office space and computer with internet facilities [E01], and are attached to DS/Director level officers in different divisions based on their interests [E01]. Upon completion, interns receive a certificate and must submit a report/paper and feedback on their experience [E02]. The internship is neither a job nor an assurance of employment [E01].", "cited_evidence_ids": ["E01", "E02"], "claim_to_evidence": [{"claim": "The programme aims to familiarize eligible students with the process of formulation of economic policies", "evidence_ids": ["E01"]}, {"claim": "Duration is two to six months at different points during the financial year", "evidence_ids": ["E01"]}, {"claim": "Token remuneration is ₹10,000 per month, payable upon satisfactory completion and submission of report/paper", "evidence_ids": ["E01"]}, {"claim": "Interns are provided with office space and computer with internet facilities", "evidence_ids": ["E01"]}, {"claim": "Interns are attached to DS/Director level officers based on their interests and division preferences", "evidence_ids": ["E01"]}, {"claim": "Interns must submit a report/paper and provide feedback upon completion", "evidence_ids": ["E02"]}, {"claim": "Certificates are issued upon satisfactory completion and submission of report/paper", "evidence_ids": ["E02"]}]}
